help.text:
UI tour (since v25 every operation is a control; the input box only carries chat text):
  Top bar   Help / Audit / Settings / Leave / Quit buttons; tabs = chat members join admin netdisk progress (tab and shift-tab cycle)
  Chat      type text then Enter or press Send (speak perm required); right-click my message = Hide / Copy, anyone's message = Copy
  Members   click selects a row, right-click opens the menu: Kick / Perms / Grant admin / Revoke admin / Transfer / Copy pubkey; blacklist row = Unban; transfer row = Endorse / Deny; appeal row = Sign unban / Ignore
  Join      select a request, right-click: Approve join (signs join) / Reject / Check seed (native file picker); the seed must hash-match genesis, only the creator can sign it
  Netdisk   Upload file uses the system picker, Quota is a number form; file row right-click = Download / Delete
  Settings  theme, language and offline threshold are forms; unavailable actions are greyed out, never hidden
  Overlays  destructive actions (kick/leave/clear/delete/hide/transfer) ask for confirmation first; esc always closes the topmost overlay
  Headless  stdin commands drive the same action table as the window buttons (v27): /join approve|reject [id], /members, /netdisk save <name> <dest>; --json emits one machine-readable object per command
